Hand colored. Relief shown pictorially. Covers the area from Quebec to Cape May, N.J., and from the Kennebec River to Lake Ontario. Shows boundaries, states, some counties, towns and cities, forts, roads, battlfields, and relief. British troops are shown at Germantown and "Frank-Fort," Pa., and Saratoga, N.Y. Includes a few historical notes. Scale ca. 1:1,200,000. LC Maps of North America, 1750-1789, 728 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault AACR2: 651
